topology: two signed production SDK browser peers over actual canonical WT/Store/Core, supplied MediaStream capture/worklet, VP8 canvas and WebAudio graph rendering; separate native topology remains required

retained_short_check_ratio.explanation: Existing150/4second checkpoint ratio remains an additional check; it does not replace the frozen video/alignment limits.

source.visual_marker: 8binary white/black8x8patches starting20,20; source identity color and moving green stripe retained
source.codec: Opus mono48k20ms32kbit; VP8640x360 up to30fps,500k target/1Mbit max; existing RTP/queue/age bounds unchanged

observer.audio: Actual renderer graph analyser, FFT2048, smoothing0, sample every5ms; strongest of80candidate bands, nearest bin plus/minus1, >-38dB and >5dB dominance, two consecutive observations
observer.video: Actual renderer canvas pixels after a successfully accepted decoded frame; RGBsum>500 is white; first observation of each uniquely decoded marker ID
observer.partial_initial_marker: Exclude IDs whose source onset preceded the measurement window; next complete onset is the minimum ID before collection starts
observer.pairing: All independently observed matching IDs are paired once; do not choose or filter pairs by latency. Record signed skew and both individual marker counts.
observer.statistics: Absolute skew; median averages middle two values for even count; p95 uses nearest rank ceil(.95*N).

resources.server: Owned Rust test host containing actual production server, separate from browser descendants/groups
resources.cpu: Sum maximum observed lifetime CPU per PID; short processes between samples may be undercounted
resources.rss: Maximum sampled sum per group; not allocation tracing
resources.scope: Whole exact test including setup/negotiation/window/teardown. Native helper absent in this topology. No capacity claim.
